content:
sara-finance: Heads up—saw a $8.6k GPU spike yesterday under project `partner-trials-2026`. Not tagged to any internal team.
lee-ops: That's the partner onboarding pipeline. We should've labeled those runs with `customer_id` and `trial=true`.
priya-accounts: Which partner? Need to know if we invoice or apply promo credits per contract.
sara-finance: Billing export shows `partner-trials-2026`. Onboarding DB has customer mapping but cloud tags missing. Likely onboarding script didn't pass labels.
billing-bot: [automated] Billing export uploaded: gs://redwood-billing/exports/2026-04/billing-2026-04.csv.gz
tom-eng: I can join instance names to onboarding DB. Instances follow pattern `trial_run_<partner>_<id>`. I'll run a regex map and upload results.
lee-ops: If it's partner X, ops can temporarily tag inventory as `cost_center=partner-platform` so finance queries reflect it. Also add a weekly alert for untagged GPU > $500.
priya-accounts: Pinged AE for Partner X and Y for direction. Need confirmation before invoicing.
tom-eng: Ran mapping: 124 instance-hours, $8,632 total; split ~72% Partner X, 28% Partner Y. Uploaded CSV: gs://redwood-finance/allocations/1935550000-partner-split.csv (finance+accounts).
lee-ops: PR to add required labels on VM create incoming. Will also add CI validation to reject unlabeled runs.
sara-finance: Finance will hold a provisional allocation to `partner-platform` for April pending accounts' decision. If partners decline, marketing trial budget may absorb it but prefer partners to cover overage.
priya-accounts: AE confirmed Partner X exceeded free trial allowance (200 free hrs). They used 550 hrs and requested an itemized invoice for the 350 overage.
sara-finance: I'll draft invoice and send to AE; cc billing@partnerx.com. Please attach run logs.
billing-bot: [automated] Alert created: projects/partner-trials-2026/alerts/untagged-gpu-weekly > $500
lee-ops: After PR merge I'll run a retroactive script to annotate historical inventory where we can match to customers.
tom-eng: Uploaded logs and per-run costs to the AE email thread.
sara-finance: Action items recap: (1) priya to confirm partner allowance & approval (48h), (2) lee merge labeling PR + retro-tag (24h), (3) tom attach logs to AE (ASAP), (4) finance draft and send invoice (tomorrow AM). Will update thread when invoice is sent.
